title.narrative: Humanitarian Energy feasibility for mini-grids Ethiopia

description.narrative:
Norad is supporting Humanitarian Energy with technical and feasibility studies for three solar-based mini-grids in the Liban zone in southern Ethiopia, in order to increase access to electricity for the refugee and host communities there. The project is based on a successful pilot mini-grid in Sheder.
HumEn is majority owned by Mercy Corps, which will in parallel run enterprise development programmes in the three communities in order to ensure a more solid base of productive use clients with a more reliable ability to pay for the mini-grids' power. The fostering of new, diversified livelihoods is crucial in a region where agriculture, which makes up the majority of commercial activity, is increasingly vulnerable to severe droughts and floods. The power can also be used to directly adapt to these risks through powered irrigation.
